fun_fact: India's peak electricity demand in September hit a high - it was the highest ever for September and only the second highest for the year. The monsoon has been significantly below normal. That means it's hotter than usual and a lot of places ACs are being used as if it were summer. The other consequence of a poor monsoon is much more reliance on other forms of irrigation -> more pumps -> more electricity. [See more](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MNAlu0nPMUk)
